warnings: Axes: x = 1-2 at 3.50; y = A-B at 4.20. Origin A1. Only 4 columns (A1, A2, B1, B2). Vector CAD PDF (pages carry /Rotate 180, rendered upright).

Every printed x/y tick is a line (section 4 rule 4): structure plans (1.10 before 1, 1.60, 1.70; 1.20, 2.50, 3.10), roof plan (1.00 overhang all round, rafter rows 1.40/2.80), stair ST-01 (0.10 before 1, 1.30 = top of run) and the truss panel chains. Before-origin dummies share grid 1's / A's prime sequence (1' -1.10, 1'' -1.00, 1''' -0.10; A' -1.00).

Truss elevations print no grid bubbles. They were positioned by their end labels and the roof plan: TRUSS T2 (4 x 0.875 = 3.50) is drawn between 'T1' (grid 1) and the อะเส (grid 2); TRUSS T1 (6 x 0.700 = 4.20) between the two 'T2' labels (rows A and B). Both chains are symmetric, so direction does not matter; their panel points became dummies.

x 1'''''' (1.70, S-01 ground floor / A-06) and 1''''''' (1.75, T2 panel point) are 0.05 apart — kept both: different sheets, different edges (ground-floor dimension tick vs truss mid panel point). x 1' (-1.10) and 1'' (-1.00) likewise: stair/beam edge vs roof edge. y A'''' (1.30, top of stair run on A-07) and A''' (1.20, F2 beam line on S-01) are different points on different sheets.

Dimension sweep covers S-01, S-02, S-04 (members only), S-05 (members only), A-06 (building sections, for levels) and A-07 (stair detail). A-03 floor plans, A-04/A-05 elevations, A-08, E-01 and SN-01/02 were not dimension-swept in this op04 run. S-03 is listed in the A-01 index but is not in the downloaded set.
A-07 prints the stair riser as '14@0.20 m. = 2.80 m.' with no level labels; it stays on the ST-01 element (section file), not as z ticks.
